title: FairCLIP: Social Bias Elimination based on Attribute Prototype Learning and Representation Neutralization

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Equal Opportunity bias (Bias@k) by comparing the proportion of male and female images in top-k image retrieval results for text queries containing bias words (e.g., 'smart', 'stupid', 'nice') against their baseline distribution in the dataset, and evaluating zero-shot classification probability differences between genders.

Calculating Equal Opportunity bias (Bias@k) by comparing the proportion of young versus non-young images in top-k image retrieval results for text queries containing bias words against their baseline distribution in the entire dataset.
